title: Agent Skill to Force Docs in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English
summary: This project introduces an agent skill that enforces ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English (STE) in documentation. It likely uses LLM-based agents to automatically check and rewrite technical content to comply with STE rules, improving clarity and consistency. The GitHub repo and Hacker News discussion suggest a practical tool for technical writers and engineers.
